extracted.intended_audience: Christian readers / devotees seeking guidance for spiritual life and devotion
extracted.subtask_description: Practical and moral guidance for living a devout Christian life: virtues to cultivate (humility, obedience, patience, resignation) and behaviors to avoid (pride, seeking consolation in creatures). The text gives prayers, reflections, and concrete exhortations for interior conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider God's hidden judgments; avoid pride in good works
rubrics_metrics.description: Qu'il faut considérer les secrets jugements de Dieu pour ne pas s'enorgueillir du bien qu'on fait.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflect on God's inscrutable judgments so you will not exalt yourself for apparent goodness. Even those whose works seemed laudable have fallen; one's holiness depends on God's sustaining hand. Anti-pattern: pride in one's virtues or attributing God's gifts to oneself — leads to abandonment and severe fall. Example exhortation: hold humble, low thoughts of oneself before God's judgments; 'Toute vanité s'éteint dans la profondeur de vos jugements.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Obedience as the essence of expiation and virtue
rubrics_metrics.description: Obedience is the essential sacrificial quality that expiates sin; imitate Christ's obedience 'jusqu'à la mort'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that the redemption and transformation of human nature hinge on infinite obedience exemplified by Christ; therefore one must submit willfully to God and to those God has placed over you. Anti-pattern: rebellious pride ('Non serviam')—the worst offense. Practical phrasing: pray for grace to submit and obey continually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ask that desires conform to God's will (resignation)
rubrics_metrics.description: When a desire arises, immediately say: 'Seigneur, qu'il soit ainsi, si c'est votre volonté.' Seek always that desires be subject to God's will.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume desires are from the Holy Spirit simply because they seem good; it is hard to discern their origin. Ask humbly for what you desire but with full resignation: 'Donnez ce que vous voulez, autant que vous le voulez et quand vous le voulez.' Adopt the posture 'mon Père, non pas ce que je veux, mais ce que vous voulez.' Anti-pattern: trusting one's desires without seeking God's judgment; unwise fervor that avoids necessary crosses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek true consolation only in God, not in creatures
rubrics_metrics.description: One should not expect ultimate consolation in present created goods; true, unmixed consolation is found only in God.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All temporal goods are fleeting and cannot fully satisfy the soul created for God. Prefer spiritual consolations and be willing to be deprived of human comfort; let God's will and trials themselves be consolations. Example: 'Que ma consolation soit d'être volontiers privé de toute consolation humaine.' Anti-pattern: avid pursuit of worldly joys as remedies for restlessness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entrust cares and disposition of life entirely to God
rubrics_metrics.description: Remettre à Dieu le soin de ce qui nous regarde; let God act as He pleases because He knows what is best.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept indifferently the states God chooses for you (darkness or light, comfort or tribulation). Be prepared for both suffering and joy; maintain a will fixed in God and ready to receive whatever He ordains. Practical posture: 'Je suis dans votre main, tournez-moi et retournez-moi en tout sens.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Endure life's miseries with constancy, following Christ's example
rubrics_metrics.description: Souffrir avec constance les misères de cette vie, à l'exemple de Jésus-Christ, who bore continual pain, poverty, ingratitude and insults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept suffering patiently as a means of sanctification and merit; Christ's life is the model. The present life, though full of sorrow, becomes a source of merit when borne with grace. Anti-pattern: seeking to avoid all suffering or seeking only ease; failing to see suffering as participation in Christ's cross.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice true patience: bear injuries without discrimination
rubrics_metrics.description: La souffrance des injures et de la véritable patience: the truly patient person suffers not only when convenient or from certain persons, but receives all adversities from God's hand with gratitude.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not claim 'I cannot bear that person' — that is not true patience. True patience does not examine who causes the suffering (superior, equal, inferior, good, or evil) but accepts trials as coming from God and counts them as gain. Anti-pattern: selective patience or complaining, refusing the spiritual combat required for the crown of patience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confess one's infirmity and acknowledge inner misery
rubrics_metrics.description: Aveu de son infirmité et des misères de cette vie: confess to God your weakness, how small things overwhelm you and interior struggles persist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize inner instability, the ease with which temptations arise, and the continual war within. Pray for divine help to be delivered from the 'boue' and to be strengthened against the 'vieil homme' and the passions. Anti-pattern: self-deception about one's strength or hiding faults; overconfidence in personal virtue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish your rest and ultimate trust in God rather than created goods
rubrics_metrics.description: Il faut établir son repos en Dieu, plutôt que dans tous les autres biens: repose-toi en Dieu above health, honors, riches, knowledge, gifts, angels, and every created thing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: God alone suffices; all gifts outside of Him are insufficient until one enjoys union with God. Cultivate longing for God and detachment from earthly ties; persist in prayer until God's interior presence returns. Example language: 'Je ne veux point vivre pour moi, mais pour vous seul.' Anti-pattern: placing final hope in creatures, fame, possessions or personal merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recall and give thanks for God's benefits regularly
rubrics_metrics.description: Du souvenir des bienfaits de Dieu: open your heart to God's law and recall with serious attention all His favors to render fitting thanksgiving.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledge that everything you have (in body, soul, inward and outward) comes from God; this remembrance fosters humility and gratitude. Avoid pride by remembering that differences in gifts do not justify glorying over others; the most fit to receive great gifts is the one who esteems themselves least. Practical: cultivate memory of benefits to spur thanksgiving and humility.
